Channel Analysis
Celebrity Collaboration was the standout channel of the quarter, delivering 32x ROI for Stellar Run's
pre-release campaign. A coordinated push involving 14 A-list celebrities generated 85 million
impressions in 10 days — unprecedented for a CineVerse release.
YouTube remained the highest-volume channel by impressions, with trailer content for Ste

annel by impressions, with trailer content for Stellar Run
accumulating 68 million views. YouTube ROI averaged 18.6x for top-performing titles.
Instagram drove the highest conversion rates among 18–34 demographics. Reel-format content for
Stellar Run achieved a 4.4% click-through rate — 2.8x the platform benchmark.
OOH (Out-of-Home) delivered solid brand visibility for premium releases but showed

brand visibility for premium releases but showed weak ROI for
comedy titles. Recommend reallocating OOH budget for lower-rated comedy releases to digital.
Key Findings
 Stellar Run's celebrity collab campaign is a replicable template for future action releases.
 Comedy titles suffer from low organic amplification — paid spend cannot compensate for weak
word-of-mouth.

 Dark Orbit's marketing ROI (7.6x) signals misalignment between campaign messaging and
audience expectations.
 Instagram Reels outperform static posts by 3.1x on conversion for all genres.
 Hotstar Ads placement drove 17.9x ROI for Stellar Run — underused for other titles.
 Tier-2 city digital spend remains under-indexed; early tests in Jaipur and Lucknow showed
positive signals.

All comedy projects currently in development have been moved t

rojects currently in development have been moved to 'Pending Review' status. The
content committee will evaluate script quality, casting alignment, and cultural relevance before any
greenlight decision. Key questions to address:
 Are scripts relying on outdated comedic tropes that no longer resonate with urban audiences?
 Is there a mismatch between the age of comedy directors and the 18–30 targ

een the age of comedy directors and the 18–30 target demographic?
 Should CineVerse commission younger writers/directors for the comedy slate?
 Can comedy be blended with action or romance to improve genre performance?
Stellar Run Franchise Plan

Given the extraordinary success of Stellar Run — ■520 Cr gross, 9.4 avg engagement score, 11 days
trending — the content board has approved a franchise plan. Stellar Run 2 is confirmed for August
2025 with an expanded budget of ■200 Cr. A limited series spin-off is under discussion for the
CineVerse OTT platform in 2026.

CineVerse Entertainment
Internal Policy Guidelines — Data, AI & Analytics
Purpose
This document outlines CineVerse's internal policies for data handling, AI system usage, and analytics
access. All employees and contractors with access to internal analytics tools must adhere to these
guidelines. Violations may result in access revocation and disciplinary action.
1. Data Classification
Level 1 — Pub

inary action.
1. Data Classification
Level 1 — Public: Aggregated performance metrics shared in press releases.
Level 2 — Internal: Detailed viewership data, regional breakdowns, engagement scores.
Level 3 — Confidential: Viewer PII, subscription tier data, marketing budgets, contract terms.
Level 4 — Restricted: Executive compensation, M&A; discussions, unreleased content.
2. AI Analytics Assista

sions, unreleased content.
2. AI Analytics Assistant — Permitted Uses
The CineVerse AI Analytics Assistant is approved for use by all employees with Level 2 clearance or
above. Permitted queries include:
 Film performance metrics (revenue, ratings, completion rates).
 Regional engagement analysis and city-level performance breakdowns.
 Genre trend analysis and audience segmentation insights.


nd analysis and audience segmentation insights.
 Marketing ROI comparisons across campaigns and channels.
 Competitive benchmarking using internal historical data.
3. AI Analytics Assistant — Prohibited Uses
 Querying individual viewer PII (names, contact details, payment information).
 Exporting raw database tables or bulk downloading viewer records.
 Using AI outputs in external communicati

ecords.
 Using AI outputs in external communications without approval from Legal.
 Attempting to bypass tool-based access controls via prompt manipulation.
 Sharing AI-generated reports externally without redacting confidential fields.
4. SQL & Data Query Policy
All database queries executed through the AI assistant are parameterised and logged. Direct database
access is not permitted outside a

Direct database
access is not permitted outside approved ETL pipelines. The AI assistant may only execute SELECT

queries on approved views — no INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, or DDL operations are permitted.
Query results exceeding 10,000 rows will be automatically truncated.
5. Retention & Audit
All AI assistant queries are logged with timestamp, user ID, query text, and tool calls executed. Logs
are retained for 90 days. Sensitive fields (viewer PII) are masked in logs. The security team conducts
monthly audits o

logs. The security team conducts
monthly audits of query logs for policy compliance.

CineVerse Entertainment
Quarterly Executive Report — Q1 2025
Executive Summary
Q1 2025 has been a landmark quarter for CineVerse Entertainment. Total platform revenue grew 38%
year-on-year, driven primarily by the extraordinary performance of Stellar Run, which became our
highest-grossing release in the streaming era. Subscription additions reached 4.2 million — our
strongest quarter since launch.

4.2 million — our
strongest quarter since launch. Premium tier uptake rose to 34% of the active user base, up from 26%
in Q4 2024.
Comedy as a genre continues to underperform expectations. Despite aggressive marketing spend on
Hasee Toh Phasee 2 and Comedy Circus, both titles posted completion rates below 55% and
audience ratings in the 5.5–6.2 range. Leadership has flagged this trend for strateg

nge. Leadership has flagged this trend for strategic review in Q2.

Underperforming Titles & Concerns
Dark Orbit (Sci-Fi, Mar 2025) — Despite the highest production budget of the quarter at ■150 Cr, the
film posted a mixed critical response (7.8 rating) and below-target completion rates of 65–72%.
Audience feedback cited a convoluted second-half plot. ROI on marketing spend was the lowest of any
2025 release at 7.2x.

Comedy genre — All three comedy releases in the past two quarters (Hasee Toh Phasee 2, Comedy
Circus, Jugaad Junction) have underperformed. Common factors include weak scripts, low social
media engagement, and poor word-of-mouth. Marketing ROI for these titles averaged just 4.6x versus
the platform average of 14.8x.

Mumbai leads all cities in views and engagement score (9.6

drama but remain underpenetrated for comedy.
